name: tree-sitter-tldr
description: The tree-sitter grammars of the metaprompt's TLDR tree (tldr) and of the prompt entries that answer it (tldr_prompt).

scripts.generate: cd tldr && tree-sitter generate --abi 14 && tree-sitter build --wasm -o tree-sitter-tldr.wasm . && cd ../tldr_prompt && tree-sitter generate --abi 14
